ValidationRule.description: When Lead status is closed lost, lead record type is pre sales and Closed lost field is empty
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Lead_Record_Type__c= 'Sales', ISPICKVAL( Lead_Status__c , 'Closed Lost'), ISBLANK(TEXT(Closed_Lost_Reason__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Closed Lost Reason.
